basis_rule: Reuse exact frozen ID calibration means/eigenvectors; no OOD fitting, scaling, whitening or selection
ood_definition: Outside PCA calibration task distribution; does not claim absence from Qwen pretraining
selection: Seeded task-specific shuffle of eligible original qwen_native OOD pilot IDs; HellaSwag24, MMLU-Pro1 per each of14 subjects; no score/answer filtering
prompt_and_scoring: Exact original qwen_native evaluation_ood request arguments, installed pinned lm_eval0.4.12 task filters/process_results and HFLM generation/likelihood
generation_budget: Keep exact original MMLU-Pro request max_gen_toks=2048 and stop settings; ID GSM8K used256, so record budget hits and do not attribute cross-task differences solely to OOD
token_rule: Same existing Full-Sync native cache path; compress pre-RoPE post-k_norm K / V at all slots1..N-2; token0 anchor, final native readout and subsequent generated KV unchanged; preserve all positions
projection: FP32 mean+(x-mean)U_kU_k^T; inject FP16; no second k_norm
id_predecessor_rule: Wait until ID compression status=completed before loading another GPU model; do not stop other jobs
